question: After the node key is bound to a canonical resolved executable identity, should completed low-risk `allow-once` model verdicts be reusable across identical exec attempts within one reviewer instance?
rationale: Code can ensure identity-safe invalidation, but only maintainers can decide whether reducing fresh security reviews is intended authorization policy.

options.title: Allow canonical bounded reuse
options.body: Permit reuse only after the node plan exposes canonical executable identity and focused coverage proves identity changes miss the memo.

options.title: Keep fresh review per exec
options.body: Retain one model security decision per execution attempt and decline the memoization policy.

recommendation.title: Allow canonical bounded reuse
recommendation.body: Permit reuse only after the node plan exposes canonical executable identity and focused coverage proves identity changes miss the memo.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core exec-authorization policy choice requiring repository-level security ownership; direct feature-history attribution remains incomplete.
